studies.title: 365 One Year in the Word
studies.description: A daily 30-minute ESV devotional with Scripture, historical context, cross-references, notes, and progress tracking.

studies.title: Hidden in My Heart
studies.description: Practice Scripture memory with verse-building, missing-word, and reference-match rounds in KJV.

studies.title: REVEALED — Bible & History Challenge
studies.description: Explore 605 Bible and history question rounds across three learning tracks, with Scripture references, answers and explanations. Track your discoveries and challenge friends.

games.title: Bible Journey: Match & Discover
games.description: Match story pairs across twelve Bible story boards, reveal Scripture and context, and play offline after installation.

games.title: Church Challenge
games.description: Create and share Scripture-based quiz challenges, including review quizzes for a Bible passage or chapter.

games.title: Kingdom Builders
games.description: Make faithful choices around service, wisdom, mercy, and stewardship while building a Christian village.

games.title: Bible Verse Sprint
games.description: A fast Scripture quiz that starts with the Roman Road and helps you review key Bible verses.
